meaning: Open inducer limit switch or condensate pressure switch.
causes: Improper venting installation or vent terminations obstructed
diySteps: Check that the condensate drain system is free flowing
Check that outdoor vent terminations are clear
Technician: correct the condensate drain or venting; check inducer limit
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if the drain and vents are clear and the code persists.
